sentences.zh: 後唐長興三年四月，中書門下奏：「據《十道圖》，舊制以王者所都之地為上，本朝都長安，遂以關內道為上。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Changxing 3 of Later Tang, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "According to the Atlas of the Ten Circuits, the old rule ranked first the place where the king made his capital; our dynasty's capital was at Chang'an, and therefore the Guannei Circuit was ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Changxing 3 of Later Tang, the Secretariat and Chancellery submitted a memorial: "According to the Atlas of the Ten Circuits, the established rule gave first rank to the ruler's capital region; our dynasty had its capital at Chang'an, and so the Guannei Circuit was placed first.

sentences.zh: 今宗廟宮闕皆在洛陽，請以河南道為上，關內道為二，河東道第三，河北道第四，劍南道第五，江南道第六，淮南道第七，山南道第八，隴右道第九，嶺南道第十。

translations.literal: Now the ancestral temples and palaces are all at Luoyang; we ask that the Henan Circuit be ranked first, the Guannei Circuit second, the Hedong Circuit third, the Hebei Circuit fourth, the Jiannan Circuit fifth, the Jiangnan Circuit sixth, the Huainan Circuit seventh, the Shannan Circuit eighth, the Longyou Circuit ninth, and the Lingnan Circuit tenth.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the ancestral temples and palace compounds are all at Luoyang, we ask that the Henan Circuit be ranked first, the Guannei Circuit second, the Hedong Circuit third, the Hebei Circuit fourth, the Jiannan Circuit fifth, the Jiangnan Circuit sixth, the Huainan Circuit seventh, the Shannan Circuit eighth, the Longyou Circuit ninth, and the Lingnan Circuit tenth.

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

translations.literal: Tianshui County and Longcheng County, Qin Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Tianshui and Longcheng counties, Qin Prefecture

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.

sentences.zh: （後唐長興三年二月，秦州奏：「見管長道、成紀、清水三縣外，有十鎮，征科並系鎮將。

translations.literal: (In the second month of Changxing 3 of Later Tang, Qin Prefecture memorialized: "Beyond the three counties presently administered—Changdao, Chengji, and Qingshui—there are ten garrisons; levies and collections all depend on the garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: [In the second month of Changxing 3 of Later Tang, Qin Prefecture submitted a memorial: "Apart from the three counties now under its administration—Changdao, Chengji, and Qingshui—there are ten garrisons, and all tax levies depend on the garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 今請以歸化、恕水、五龍、黃土四鎮就歸化鎮復置舊隴城縣，赤砂、染坊、夕陽、南冶、鐵務五鎮就赤砂鎮復置舊天水縣。

translations.literal: We now ask that from the four garrisons of Guihua, Shushui, Wulong, and Huangtu, centered on Guihua Garrison, the former Longcheng County be re-established; and from the five garrisons of Chisha, Ranfang, Xiyang, Nanye, and Tiewu, centered on Chisha Garrison, the former Tianshui County be re-established.
translations.idiomatic: We now ask that the four garrisons of Guihua, Shushui, Wulong, and Huangtu, taken together at Guihua Garrison, be used to restore the former Longcheng County, and that the five garrisons of Chisha, Ranfang, Xiyang, Nanye, and Tiewu, taken together at Chisha Garrison, be used to restore the former Tianshui County.

sentences.zh: 其白石、大澤、良恭三鎮割屬長道縣。

translations.literal: The three garrisons of Baishi, Daze, and Lianggong should be transferred to Changdao County.
translations.idiomatic: The three garrisons of Baishi, Daze, and Lianggong should be reassigned to Changdao County.

translations.literal: " Approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.]

translations.literal: Tonggu County and Liting County, Cheng Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Tonggu and Liting counties, Cheng Prefecture

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.

sentences.zh: （後唐清泰三年六月，秦州奏：「階州元管將利、福津兩縣，並無遷鎮，成州元管同谷縣，餘並是鎮，便系征科。

translations.literal: (In the sixth month of Qingtai 3 of Later Tang, Qin Prefecture memorialized: "Jie Prefecture originally administered the two counties of Jiangli and Fujin, with no relocated garrisons. Cheng Prefecture originally administered Tonggu County; the rest were all garrisons, and levies were tied to them.
translations.idiomatic: [In the sixth month of Qingtai 3 of Later Tang, Qin Prefecture submitted a memorial: "Jie Prefecture originally administered Jiangli and Fujin counties and had no relocated garrisons. Cheng Prefecture originally administered Tonggu County; everything else was garrison territory, and levies were collected through the garrisons.

sentences.zh: 今欲取成州西南近便鎮分並入同谷縣，其東界四鎮，別創一縣者，州西南有府城、長豐、魏平三鎮，其地東至泥陽鎮界二十五里，北至黃竹路金砂鎮界五十里，南至興州界三十里，西至白石鎮界一百一十里，西南至舊階州界砂地嶺四十五里。

translations.literal: We now wish to take nearby garrisons on the southwest of Cheng Prefecture and merge portions into Tonggu County. As for the four garrisons on the eastern border, for which a separate county should be created: on the southwest of the prefecture are the three garrisons of Fucheng, Changfeng, and Weiping. The territory extends east to the boundary of Niyang Garrison twenty-five li, north to the boundary of Jinsha Garrison on the Huangzhu Road fifty li, south to the boundary of Xing Prefecture thirty li, west to the boundary of Baishi Garrison one hundred ten li, and southwest to Shadi Ridge on the old border with Jie Prefecture forty-five li.
translations.idiomatic: We now wish to take the convenient nearby garrisons on Cheng Prefecture's southwest and merge their districts into Tonggu County. Regarding the four garrisons on the eastern border, for which a separate county should be created: on the prefecture's southwest are the three garrisons of Fucheng, Changfeng, and Weiping. That territory extends twenty-five li east to the border of Niyang Garrison, fifty li north to the border of Jinsha Garrison on the Huangzhu Road, thirty li south to the border of Xing Prefecture, one hundred ten li west to the border of Baishi Garrison, and forty-five li southwest to Shadi Ridge on the old border with Jie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其三鎮管界並入同谷縣，廢其鎮額。

translations.literal: The jurisdictions of these three garrisons should all be merged into Tonggu County, and their garrison designations abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The jurisdictions of all three garrisons should be merged into Tonggu County, and their garrison titles abolished.

sentences.zh: 州東界有勝仙、泥陽、金砂、栗亭四鎮，東至鳳州美贍鎮界十五里，南至果州界二十里，北至高橋三十五里，西至同谷界三十五里，北至秦州界六十七里，欲並其四鎮地於栗亭縣。

translations.literal: On the eastern border of the prefecture are the four garrisons of Shengxian, Niyang, Jinsha, and Liting. East to the boundary of Meishan Garrison in Feng Prefecture fifteen li, south to the boundary of Guo Prefecture twenty li, north to Gaoqiao thirty-five li, west to the boundary with Tonggu thirty-five li, north to the boundary with Qin Prefecture sixty-seven li. We wish to combine the territory of these four garrisons into Liting County.
translations.idiomatic: On the prefecture's eastern border are the four garrisons of Shengxian, Niyang, Jinsha, and Liting. That area lies fifteen li east to the border of Meishan Garrison in Feng Prefecture, twenty li south to the border of Guo Prefecture, thirty-five li north to Gaoqiao, thirty-five li west to the border with Tonggu, and sixty-seven li north to the border with Qin Prefecture. We ask that the lands of all four garrisons be combined into Liting County.

sentences.zh: 其征科委縣司，捕盜委鎮司。

translations.literal: Tax levies shall be entrusted to the county office; apprehension of bandits shall be entrusted to the garrison office.
translations.idiomatic: Tax collection should be entrusted to the county office, and bandit suppression to the garrison office.

translations.literal: " Approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.]

translations.literal: (In the third month of Kaiyun 3 of Jin, Quanyi County of Gui Prefecture was elevated to a prefecture; Quanyi County was also changed to Dechang County; and Linchuan, Guangming, and Yining counties of Gui Prefecture were transferred to its jurisdiction—pursuant to the memorial of Ma Xifan of Hunan.)〉
translations.idiomatic: [In the third month of Kaiyun 3 of Jin, Quanyi County of Gui Prefecture was elevated to prefecture status; Quanyi was renamed Dechang County; and Linchuan, Guangming, and Yining counties of Gui Prefecture were reassigned to it, as approved on the memorial of Ma Xifan of Hunan.]
